note: State park on Split Rock Lake, a reservoir behind a 1930s WPA dam on Split Rock Creek, near Jasper. The campground sits in shade trees on the lake's west shore; swimming beach, fishing pier and small-boat access, canoe, kayak and paddleboard rental in summer, and mowed prairie hiking trails. --Claude
